components.name: Weather card
components.description: Responsive location card with current condition and today's key weather facts.
components.css: .weather-card { padding:20px; border:1px solid #dfe3df; border-radius:18px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 9px 25px #15283a08; }

components.name: Refresh control
components.description: Keyboard-operable action that reloads the current dashboard contract.
components.css: .refresh { min-height:39px; border:1px solid #ffffff32; border-radius:12px; color:#fff; background:#ffffff0b; }

components.name: Status banner
components.description: Textual partial- or full-failure notice independent of color.
components.html: 날씨 제공 서비스에 일시적으로 연결할 수 없습니다.
components.css: .status-banner { padding:13px 16px; border:1px solid #ddc86a; border-radius:13px; background:#fff9d9; color:#695a1b; }

narrative.overview: A navy and warm-paper weather and exchange-rate dashboard with lime accents.
keyCharacteristics: 17 administrative-region weather cards with current and daily values.
A clear KRW exchange-rate table and functional conversion panel.
Explicit loading, partial-success, and external-service failure states.
rules: Do not fabricate data when a provider is unavailable.
Keep Korean text and responsive card layouts legible without horizontal page overflow.
dos: Use source names and reference dates alongside displayed data.
Preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not present reference rates as executable financial prices.
Do not require API credentials from the browser.
